# SolveXia

> > SolveXia is a data automation platform specializing in financial process automation, rebate management, account reconciliation, and regulatory compliance for finance teams.

SolveXia provides no-code automation solutions that integrate with enterprise systems like SAP and Oracle to streamline financial operations including month-end close, rebate calculations, balance sheet reconciliation, and regulatory reporting. The platform serves industries from healthcare to finance with workflow automation and data transformation capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Financial Automation
- Rebate Management
- Account Reconciliation
- Month-End Close
- Workflow Automation
- Data Management
- Regulatory Reporting
- Process Improvement
- Financial Reporting
- Volume Rebates
- ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)
- Data Transformation
- Compliance Risk Management
- Business Process Management (BPM)
- Payment Processing

## Core Solutions

- [Rebate Management Software](https://www.solvexia.com/solutions/rebate-management-software): Automated rebate management software for calculations and reporting
- [Health and Medtech](https://www.solvexia.com/solutions/healthcare): Healthcare and medtech automation solutions with SAP/Oracle integration
